dedupe_keys.name: a global urban road network self adaptive simplification workflow from traffic to spatial representation

description: A global urban road network self-adaptive simplification workflow from traffic to spatial representation is a software or model described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xinzhuo Zhao et al. Urban road networks help describe the spatial logic of urban organization and evolution. However, existing urban road network datasets like OpenStreetMap are designed for traffic studies, treating each lane as a distinct spatial unit of mobility, which may not align with urban studies considering each road as an integration space for social and cultural dynamics. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: GeoJSON. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2746223373 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
